# `gcp.backendbucket`

Backend buckets allow you to use Google Cloud Storage buckets with HTTP(S) load balancing. An HTTP(S) load balancer can direct traffic to specified URLs to a backend bucket rather than a backend service. It can send requests for static content to a Cloud Storage bucket and requests for dynamic content to a virtual machine instance.
